ns2:section.sectionText: CEE 598 SRC - Shared Rail Corridor Engineering & Operations Prerequisites: CEE 408, 409, 410, 411, 498 HSR or permission from the instructor. Increased speed, frequency and/or expansion of rail passenger service in North America is expected to make substantial use of lines shared with freight trains. Although freight and passenger trains have shared infrastructure since the beginning of rail transport, the engineering design and operational practices of each have become increasingly specialized and divergent over the past five decades. North American plans for such shared infrastructure operations pose engineering, operational and institutional challenges that are unique in the world.
